failures.what: Opus review envelope rejected by validateReviewResult (issue length 326 > 300)

envelope.summary: Read-only review of T-8025 using the supplied diff and files. The structured verdict path is mostly sound. It fails on one medium finding: the review-job heuristic can reroute non-review jobs, which breaks the requirement that non-review jobs stay unchanged. There is also one low finding: a review envelope with non-empty files or edits is not rejected.

findings.issue: isReadOnlyReviewJob treats any job with outputs [] and an id starting with review-, acc-review- or sec-review- as a review job. This holds even when type is not 'review'. Such a job gets the review schema, the review instructions and forced result.reviews validation. Non-review jobs are therefore not byte-for-byte unchanged.
findings.fix: Key review handling on job.type === 'review' only, or on an explicit flag set by the manifest builders. Drop the id-prefix fallback.

findings.issue: The review schema's maxItems:0 on files and edits is removed by anthropicSchema. validateEnvelope/validateReviewResult never checks that files and edits are empty for a review job, so a read-only review can return file writes that pass envelope validation.
findings.fix: In validateEnvelope, when review is true, fail closed unless value.files and value.edits are both empty arrays.

result.notes: The verdict is read only from the whole-JSON envelope (reviews or result.reviews) or from the final verdict line. result.notes is never parsed for verdicts. Envelope validation fails closed on a missing or malformed result for review jobs. The format re-ask behavior in the recorders was not in the supplied files and could not be verified.
